LOOK: Militant women’s group Gabriela stages a protest at the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) main office in Intramuros, Manila, on Wednesday, September 3, urging the poll body to immediately proclaim Gabriela Women’s Party (GWP) as a winner in Congress. 

The group stresses that with the COMELEC en banc’s affirmation of Duterte Youth’s disqualification, no legal obstacle remains, making it necessary for Gabriela, as the next eligible party-list, to be officially proclaimed.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
